sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Pilosity moderate. Head yellow to yellow-brown, mandibles darker. Length with wings 27.2—27.5 mm, length without wings 12.5—14.8 mm. Head subcircular, wider than long (maximum width 2.70—3.40 mm, length to the lateral mandible base 2.40—3.00 mm), posterior margin rounded; coronal suture present, fontanelle absent. Compound eyes large, nearly oval, the margin facing the antenna nearly straight. Ocelli small, almost flush with the head surface. Antennae 26—29-segmented, mostly 27-segmented (Afghan specimens only 24-segmented, Weidner 1970); segment 1 longest, segment 2 less than half of segment 1, segments 3—5 subequal and shortest. Frons weakly striolate. Anteclypeus large, hairless. Postclypeus relatively narrow, with a few hairs near the anterior margin. Labrum much wider than long, the sides convex at the middle; anterior margin nearly straight, with a shallow median notch; anterior margin and labral surface with several longer hairs. Left mandible with 3 marginal teeth beyond the apical tooth, the second very small and remote from the third; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth beyond the apical tooth, the two close together. Pronotum narrower than the head, weakly saddle-shaped; anterior margin convex with a small median notch, posterior margin weakly convex with a small median notch. Legs robust, hairy; tarsi 4-segmented; tibial spur formula 3 : 4 : 4. Wings reticulate; wing-surface microstructure consisting of numerous papillate protuberances (3—6 × 2—4 μm) and warts (2—3 × 2—3 μm), without microspines. The bases of the main veins of both wings lie within the basal scale; Sc short, R with 4 branches, Rs with 6 branches, M with 3 branches, Cu with 4 main branches, anal absent; hindwing generally as forewing. Cerci 1-segmented, small, subconical, 0.28—0.30 mm long; styli 1-segmented, short, 0.08—0.10 mm long, present in both sexes.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Pilosity sparse. Head yellow to yellow-brown. Total length including mandibles 10.0—16.7 mm. Head subquadrate, slightly longer than wide (length to the lateral mandible base 3.00—4.90 mm, maximum width 2.70—4.56 mm), widest in the posterior half, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle absent. Frons smooth or only weakly wrinkled. Compound eyes small, subcircular. Ocelli as small, subcircular spots. Antennae 25—31-segmented; segment 1 longest, segment 2 about half of segment 1, segment 3 subequal to segment 2, segment 4 smallest. Anteclypeus a narrow trapezoidal, hairless membranous band. Postclypeus indistinctly delimited, with a few hairs anteriorly. Labrum broad, subrectangular, much wider than long; anterior part and labral surface with a few hairs; anterior corners rounded; anterior margin nearly straight, with a shallow median notch. Mandibles long and robust, incurved apically; each with 2 large marginal teeth. Postmentum rod-like, widest at the anterior third; anterior margin nearly straight to undulate, posterior margin straight to weakly convex. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, much wider than long (width 1.82—3.25 mm, length 0.98—1.80 mm); anterior margin convex with a weak median notch, posterior margin convex with a strong median notch; margins and surface with a few hairs. Mesonotum much wider than long, sides straight, posterior margin slightly convex. Metanotum with straight sides and a weakly convex posterior margin. Legs long and stout, sparsely hairy; tarsi 4-segmented; tibial spur formula 3 : 4 : 4. Cerci short, 1-segmented, 0.18—0.25 mm long; styli short, 1-segmented, 0.10—0.15 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow-brown. Total length 6.1—10.6 mm. Head subquadrate, slightly wider than long (width 1.6—3.3 mm, length 1.4—2.9 mm); coronal suture present. Fontanelle absent. Compound eyes circular, medium-sized (diameter about 0.4 mm). Ocelli very small. Antennae 25—31-segmented, segment 5 smallest. Anteclypeus relatively small; postclypeus very narrow, not always distinct. Labrum and mandibles as in the alate. Pronotum much narrower than the head, sparsely hairy, subtrapezoidal, strongly convex anteriorly; much wider than long; anterior margin strongly convex with a weak median notch, posterior margin nearly straight without a median notch. Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, much wider than long, with several rows of hairs near the convex posterior margin. Metanotum much wider than long, with several rows of hairs near the posterior margin. Legs long and slender; tarsi 4-segmented; tibial spur formula 3 : 4 : 4. Cerci short, 0.15—0.20 mm long (recorded by Gupta 1962b as weakly 3-segmented); styli short, 1-segmented, 0.13—0.15 mm long.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Bose (1988), original in English; the alate, soldier and worker sections are all present; figure numbers (Fig. 5—9), measurement tables (Table 1—3), type specimens and locality records, and synonyms are not translated; the original gives no pronotal measurements in the alate section, and in the OCR that set of values appears in the soldier section (repeated across the page break), so it is assigned here to the soldier only.
